subject: Stellarsys purchase path: procurement stitching, MAP & billing lattice
messages:
From: sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
To: anna.lopez@stellarsys.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + proposed MAP and billing questions for AWS private offer path

Hi Anna —

Great speaking earlier. Per our call, I sketched a concise mutual action plan (MAP) that bridges the evaluation sprint to the private-offer purchase path on AWS. The goals: get a 30-day eval running in your staging account, confirm performance & cost at target throughput, and land the AWS Private Offer with a billing mapping that routes charges to your marketplace account.

Attached: Stellarsys_MAP_v1.xlsx (short milestones + owners).

Questions I flagged for your procurement team so we can iterate before we loop Seller Assist:
- Preferred billing account for Marketplace (AWS account ID or payer org)?
- Any PO template details we should pre-fill (line items, billing contact)?
- Data residency / retention constraints to note for the private deployment?

Next step: if you’re good, can we schedule a MAP kickoff next Tue 10/24 10am PT? I’ll pull in Laura from CS for the evaluation plan and Ben for commercial/PO coordination.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: Stellarsys_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: anna.lopez@stellarsys.com

Cc: marcus.green@stellarsys.com
Date: Fri, 20 Oct 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP and billing questions for AWS private offer path

Thanks Sofia — this looks promising. A few quick notes from procurement:

- We prefer to bill through our central payer account (payer ID 123456789012).
- I'll attach our PO template for your legal team to pre-fill: Stellarsys_PO_Template.pdf.
- Data residency: EU-only workloads for PHI-derived data. Our evaluation will be limited to non-PHI datasets in the staging run.

We can do Tue 10/24 10am PT for the kickoff. Marcus (cc’d) will join as the procurement owner. Please include a short acceptance criteria section in the MAP so Legal can sign off quicker.

Also: we plan to request a Marketplace Private Offer (Seller Assist) rather than a direct invoice. Can you confirm Redwood has experience with Seller Assist flows on both AWS and Azure?

Best,
Anna Lopez
Head of Cloud Procurement | StellarSys
anna.lopez@stellarsys.com | +1 (206) 555-9987

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: anna.lopez@stellarsys.com, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 23 Oct 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP and billing questions for AWS private offer path

Hi Anna / Sofia —

Thanks for the PO template — I reviewed and prefilled the sections that typically speed procurement: line item descriptions, unit pricing cadence for tokens/embeddings, and billing contact details. I added a short Acceptance Criteria block at the bottom of the MAP so Legal has a checklist:

MAP highlights (high level):
- Eval kickoff: Staging env credentials provided by 10/25; baseline perf tests (p50/p95) by 10/29.
- Quality gate: production-predictive prompts (10 sampled prompt sets) must meet 95% pass per your rubric by 10/31.
- Post-eval commercial decision: PO to be issued within 7 business days of acceptance.

Attached: I saved my MAP edits to Stellarsys_MAP_v1.xlsx and exported a billing matrix CSV that maps marketplace SKUs to our internal product codes (redwood-billing-matrix.csv).

On Seller Assist: yes — Redwood has completed Seller Assist PO routing on AWS and Azure for several customers. The typical flow:
1) We confirm the SKU(s) and quantities.
2) Seller Assist creates the Private Offer and links it to your payer account.
3) Once signed, AWS issues charges to the linked payer.

We’ll treat Legal items as a parallel path during your eval so procurement can issue the PO quickly after acceptance.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0204

Attachments: Stellarsys_MAP_v1.xlsx (updated), redwood-billing-matrix.csv (text/csv)

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: anna.lopez@stellarsys.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Oct 2028 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP and billing questions for AWS private offer path

Anna — quick commercial note from my side:

Glad to hear Seller Assist matches your preference. From a deal perspective, we can:
- Reserve a 20% consumption credit for the first 60 days of the contract to cover the evaluation spikes (applies only if you convert to a 12-month committed term).
- Pre-authorize an estimated invoice schedule in the PO (monthly billing) so your procurement team can map budget lines.

Rishi — can you confirm the exact metadata we should include on the Private Offer so AWS links the invoice to payer ID 123456789012? Also, any billing nuances if StellarSys wants charges routed to a consolidated payer but billed by Redwood?

Happy to discuss on our kickoff call 10/24.

—Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0119

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, anna.lopez@stellarsys.com, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 02 Nov 2028 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + proposed MAP and billing questions for AWS private offer path

Hi all — following up after our kickoff and the MAP updates. Summary and concrete procurement steps so procurement/legal can act without delay: 

Procurement & Marketplace steps (recommended order):
1) Confirm SKU list + estimated monthly consumption (Ben to confirm numbers; see redwood-billing-matrix.csv).
2) Redwood to prepare Private Offer package: SKU mapping, quantity tiers, and Offer ID stub.
3) Customer to create a Marketplace Purchase Request and provide the payer ID (StellarSys payer 123456789012).
4) Seller Assist (AWS) will link the Private Offer to your payer after Seller Assist accepts the package (work generally completes within 3–5 business days).
5) Customer issues PO referencing the Private Offer ID and Redwood’s billing contact. We recommend: line item for committed units + monthly true-up.
6) If StellarSys wants consolidated billing (payer pays and distributes internally), add the payer org as the billing recipient; Redwood will invoice the payer directly and send an AP summary.

Docs we need from your side this week to keep timeline: signed PO referencing Private Offer ID, contact for AWS Seller Assist (if you have a rep), and confirmation on whether the evaluation usage will be token-metered or reserved capacity.

Operational notes:
- For EU-only datasets, we’ll run evaluation jobs in our eu-west-1 deployment and provide KV-cache isolation.
- If you want an on-prem/private deployment later, we can include a migration appendix in the SOW.

Links: HubSpot deal RDW-4729: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4729
DocuSign SOW link (draft): https://www.docusign.com/sign?doc=RDW-4729-SOW

Next milestone target dates (proposed):
- 11/06: PO issued with Private Offer ID
- 11/09: Seller Assist links offer to payer
- 11/13: Charges begin flowing to payer; first monthly invoice generated

If that timeline works, I’ll bundle the Private Offer package and route to Anna’s PO contact.

Rishi Malhotra
Finance & Billing Ops | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
